ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Students are recommended to have high speed internet access for the use of the Elluminate Software system for the live class sessions. Also required is an external microphone or microphone/headset (preferred for better quality sound) for required course discussions during the online virtual classroom sessions. This section is restricted to news-editorial majors only. Disregard the assessment notations listed. The undergrad tuition rate is $277 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee. These per credit hour assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
